text: 中国卫星公告，预计2026 年半年度实现归属于母公司所有者的净利润为3,050万元到3,650万元，与上年同期相比，将实现扭亏为盈。
text_en: China Satellite announced that it expects net profit attributable to parent company shareholders for the first half of 2026 to be between 30.5 million yuan and 36.5 million yuan, turning a profit compared to the same period last year.
